status: PROOF-OF-CONCEPT CONTRACT — one fixed Northstar v2 body and pose for generated clothing items; not approved for production, no image call, R3 stays default OFF
experiment: D-198: kept as a DOCUMENTED EXPERIMENT, not a production standard. The fit was shown with derivatives of Northstar's own clothing (recolours, deformations) and with SIMULATED generated input; it is NOT proven on any GPT-generated item. Its rule that every item covers Northstar's tee, jeans and sneakers is not carried over: contract-v2.json targets a base figure with arms, legs and feet.

source.use: the master's own painted outfit becomes the DEFAULT item of each category; the D-194 R3 head stack and the master's arms and hands are the base figure

notUsed: H1 (fitting-base.H1.png) — banned; this contract does not recreate a bare or close-fitting fitting body
the R2 base (a different figure and pose: silhouette IoU 0.77 against Northstar v2)

canvas.space: Northstar v2 master coordinates, unchanged; every item is a full-canvas RGBA layer set in these coordinates

top.rule: covers the default tee completely; top-body lies UNDER the arms, top-sleeves (inside the sleeve zone) OVER them; the hem lies over the pants; never on the hands; ends above the crotch band

pants.rule: covers the default jeans completely; lies under the top and the hands; may widen and may cover the shoe tops down to the ground band

shoes.rule: covers the default sneakers completely; lies under the pants (a boot shaft runs under the hem); the soles stand on the fixed ground line

outOfScope: garments that would reveal skin the base does not have — sleeveless or off-shoulder tops, crop tops, necklines below the default collar, shorts, skirts, rolled-up hems, sandals, bare feet. They need owner-approved limb material first; a fitting body under clothing is not part of this system.

extraction.keyNote: the generator receives and returns an OPAQUE picture (transparent output is refused by the model, D-151): the base figure on a flat magenta key; magenta is forbidden in every item prompt

gateCalibration: minSharpness is mean |Laplacian| / mean |gradient| over the item's opaque interior (contrast-independent). Measured: Northstar's own garments and their recolours and warped stimuli 0.76–1.01; the same after a 3x3 blur or a soft 2x upscale 0.39–0.61. minOutlineShare: Northstar's garments 0.85–1.00; the foreign R2 armour 0.33.
